cs.t: For me it was Google Maps on my iPhone SE, but that was several years ago.  The great GUI design for the display size is what made the classic iPhone size work.  Essentially Apple decided to allow apps to be published that were terrible on smaller devices and I realized those horses weren't going to get back into the barn. So I switched to a Samsung Flip, and I've learned that a device that has a large display and fits in my pocket is a reasonable compromise.  Now they just need to be a reasonable price.
cs.th: Nobody designs for small iPhone devices anymore
